long_description:
Verity is a save editor for the Gen 4 and 5 Pokémon games (DPPt, HGSS, BW, B2W2) that checks legality as you edit.

You need a Gen 4 or 5 game on your SD card: Verity loads its fonts and sprites from it, so nothing from Nintendo is included in the download.

Features:
- Legality checks ported from PKHeX, run on the DS itself
- Won't let an edit make a Pokémon illegal
- Generate legal wild encounters and Gen 4 eggs
- Receive event gifts from the deliveryman
- Edit the bag
- BW to B2W2 Memory Link

It edits saves on the SD card directly and keeps your previous three saves as .bak1 to .bak3.

There's also a browser version at https://verity.llamington.workers.dev
